strategy.summary: Hit the file cabinet until its drawer opens, then enter it to start Multiball. Make two left-ramp Jackpots, the timed right-ramp Double Jackpot, and the cabinet Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: File Cabinet Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Repeated cabinet hits lower the drawer; shooting the open drawer starts three-ball play.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot sequence
quickInfo.summary: Two left-ramp jackpots light a brief right-ramp Double Jackpot, followed by a cabinet Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Restart
quickInfo.summary: If no jackpot was made before one-ball play, the cabinet may offer one brief restart window.

quickInfo.name: Episodes
quickInfo.summary: The scoop starts the displayed episode for safer incremental scoring when the cabinet is dangerous.

steps.text: Test the file-cabinet rebound and both ramp returns while ball save is active.
Hit the file cabinet until its upper drawer opens.
Shoot the open drawer to start File Cabinet Multiball.
Shoot the left ramp for the first Jackpot, then repeat the left ramp for the second Jackpot.
Transfer quickly to the right ramp for the timed Double Jackpot.
Shoot the file cabinet for the Super Jackpot, then begin the sequence again while two balls remain.
modeNotes: Multiball order: Left ramp, left ramp, timed right ramp, then file cabinet for the Super Jackpot.

steps.text: If Multiball ends before any jackpot, shoot the cabinet during its one brief restart window, then take the first left-ramp Jackpot after the relaunch.

fallback.title: Episode scoring
fallback.when: Use this when the cabinet face or its drawer eject is unsafe.

steps.text: Shoot the scoop to start the available episode.
Take the episode shots with the cleanest returns.
Return to the cabinet only after its feed can be attacked from control.
Collect the timed right-ramp Double Jackpot.
Cash the cabinet Super Jackpot and repeat the sequence.

techniques.name: Ramp transfer
techniques.instruction: After the second left ramp, prepare the receiving flipper for the brief right-ramp Double Jackpot.

cautions.issue: Multiball begins without a long opening grace period.
cautions.response: Do not plunge blindly; establish control and make the first left ramp promptly.

cautions.issue: Cabinet switches, drawer travel, and eject behavior vary by physical condition.
cautions.response: Test registration and the return before using the cabinet as a repeated tournament shot.

strategy.simpleOverview: The X Files turns the file cabinet and two ramps into a repeatable Multiball ladder. Hit the cabinet until its drawer opens and enter it, shoot the left ramp twice, transfer to the briefly lit right-ramp Double Jackpot, then hit the cabinet for Super Jackpot before beginning the sequence again.
strategy.overview: Repeated cabinet hits open its drawer and start The X Files' three-ball Multiball, whose Jackpots follow a fixed left-left-right-cabinet order. Execute the sequence from controlled feeds. Use the one restart window after an empty Multiball, or play Episodes at the scoop when cabinet rebounds make that loop unsafe.
